en.title: Basketball Zero
en.description: Active Basketball Zero codes for a fast-paced, anime-inspired 5v5 basketball game with character classes, special abilities, and unique auras.
tips: Join the developer's official Roblox group before redeeming codes so your rewards can be granted.
Use your spins to unlock new playstyles, zones, and auras for your character.
Hold the left mouse button to shoot, or tap it briefly to perform a pump fake.
Press Q for quick dribbles and use the Spacebar for layups or dunks.

redeem.title: How to redeem codes in Basketball Zero
redeem.description: Follow these steps to redeem active Basketball Zero codes.
steps: Open the official Basketball Zero page on Roblox and join the developer group, Current.
Like the experience on Roblox, then launch Basketball Zero.
Click the purple CODES button at the bottom of the screen.
Enter or paste an active code exactly as shown in the list above.
Press REDEEM to confirm the code.

pt-BR.description: Códigos ativos de Basketball Zero para um jogo de basquete 5v5 acelerado e inspirado em animes, com classes, habilidades especiais e auras únicas.

redeem.title: Como resgatar códigos em Basketball Zero
redeem.description: Siga estas etapas para resgatar códigos ativos de Basketball Zero.
steps: Abra a página oficial de Basketball Zero no Roblox e entre no grupo do desenvolvedor, Current.
Curta a experiência no Roblox e depois inicie Basketball Zero.
Clique no botão roxo CODES localizado na parte inferior da tela.
Digite ou cole um código ativo exatamente como aparece na lista acima.
Pressione REDEEM para confirmar o resgate.
